title: China holds at least one craft, via Puthoff

tellings.quote: China is like a closed door I know through how put up that they have at least one and I think he might have gotten that officially through some work he did with the DIA

plain: China has at least one recovered craft of unknown origin, the physicist Eric W. Davis tells Michels. He says China is 'like a closed door', and that he knows this through the researcher Hal Puthoff, who he thinks learned it officially through work with the DIA, the Pentagon's military intelligence agency. If true, it would mean the United States is not the only country holding such an object.
